q1.explanationZh: define 动词“给……下定义”，名词是 definition“定义”。

q2.explanationZh: definite 形容词“明确的；一定的”，结尾是 -ite，不要写成 -ate。

q3.explanationZh: 形容词 definite 加 -ly 构成副词 definitely“明确地；肯定地”，保留词尾的 e。

q4.explanationZh: define 去 e 加 -ition 构成名词 definition“定义”。

q5.explanationZh: degree 名词“学位；度数；程度”，结尾是两个 e，如 a master’s degree“硕士学位”。

q6.explanationZh: delay 可作名词和动词“推迟；耽搁”，without delay“毫不耽搁”。

q7.explanationZh: delegate 名词“代表”，派生词 delegation“代表团”。

q8.explanationZh: delete 动词“删除”，注意两个 e：de-le-te。

q9.explanationZh: deliberate 形容词“故意的；慎重的”，副词是 deliberately“故意地”。

q10.explanationZh: delicate 形容词“纤细的；易碎的；细腻的”，结尾是 -cate。

q12.explanationZh: delight 作动词“使高兴”，作名词“高兴”，注意 -ight 的拼写。

q13.explanationZh: deliver 动词“投递；发表”，名词是 delivery。

q14.explanationZh: deliver 加 -y 构成名词 delivery“投递；讲演”。

q15.explanationZh: demand 可作动词和名词“要求；需要”，in demand“受欢迎的”。

q16.explanationZh: demand 加 -ing 构成形容词 demanding“要求高的；费力的”。

q17.explanationZh: democracy“民主”，结尾是 -cracy，形容词是 democratic。

q18.explanationZh: demonstrate 动词“论证；示范；示威游行”，名词是 demonstration。

q19.explanationZh: dense 形容词“稠密的；密集的”，be dense with“……密集”。

q20.explanationZh: dentist“牙医”，go to the dentist’s“去看牙医”。

q21.explanationZh: deny 动词“否认；拒绝”，后接动名词：There is no denying that...“无可否认……”。

q22.explanationZh: depart 不及物动词“离开；出发”，名词是 departure。

q23.explanationZh: depart 加 -ment 构成名词 department“部门”。

q24.explanationZh: depart 的名词形式是 departure“离开；出发”，结尾是 -ure。

q25.explanationZh: depend 不及物动词，常用 depend on“依靠；取决于”。

q26.explanationZh: depend 加 -ent 构成形容词 dependent“依靠的”，be dependent on“依赖……”。

q27.explanationZh: deposit 可作动词“存放；沉淀”和名词“存款；定金”，注意中间是 o：de-po-sit。

q28.explanationZh: depress 动词“使沮丧”，结尾双写 s；形容词 depressed“沮丧的”。

q29.explanationZh: depth 是 deep 的名词形式“深度”，in depth“深（度）为……”。

q30.explanationZh: describe 动词“描述”，名词是 description。

q31.explanationZh: describe 去 be 改为 -ption 构成名词 description“描写”，beyond description“无法形容”。

accept: to define the position of the government
define the position of the government

q32.explanationZh: define 意为“使明确；阐述”，to define the position of the government“阐述政府的立场”。

q33.explanationZh: in demand“需要的，受欢迎的”，如 be in great demand“很受欢迎”。

q34.explanationZh: There is no denying that...“无可否认……”，deny 在 no 后用动名词 denying。

q35.explanationZh: department 意为“部门”，销售部是 the Sales Department。

q36.explanationZh: depend on“取决于；依靠”，介词用 on。

q37.explanationZh: beyond description“无法形容”，beyond 表示“超出……范围”。

q38.explanationZh: deposit 作名词“存款”，current deposit“活期存款”。

q39.explanationZh: describe ... as ...“把……称为，把……说成”，介词用 as。

q40.explanationZh: to one’s delight“使某人高兴的是”，常放在句首，如 To my delight, ...

q41.explanationZh: delight in 或 take delight in 都表示“对……感到高兴”，介词用 in。

q42.explanationZh: be dense with“……密集”，路上车辆多，填 dense。

q43.explanationZh: in depth 表示“深度为……”，介词后用名词 depth。

q44.explanationZh: does 后接动词原形，depart“出发；离开”。

q46.explanationZh: 主语 Wet weather 是第三人称单数，一般现在时，depress 加 -es：depresses“使沮丧”。

q47.explanationZh: The 后需要名词，depart 的名词形式 departure“出发”。

q48.explanationZh: to one’s delight“使某人高兴的是”，my 后用名词 delight。

q49.explanationZh: to 后接动词原形，demonstrate 作不及物动词表示“示威游行”。

q50.explanationZh: go to the dentist’s 表示“去看牙医（去牙医诊所）”，dentist 后加 ’s。

q51.explanationZh: must 后接动词原形，delay“推迟”，天气好转前推迟行程。

q52.explanationZh: 修饰名词 action 用形容词，deliberate action“慎重的措施”。

q53.explanationZh: recorded 后需要名词，recorded delivery“挂号邮寄”。

q54.explanationZh: in great demand“需求量大；很受欢迎”。

q55.explanationZh: shall 后接动词原形，deliver“送货；投递”。

q56.explanationZh: be dependent on“依赖……”，is 后用形容词 dependent。

q57.explanationZh: will 后接动词原形，deposit 作不及物动词“沉淀”。

q58.sampleAnswer: With his delicate brushstrokes, the young painter quickly earned recognition within the art industry and orders poured in.
references: With his delicate brushstrokes, the young painter quickly earned recognition within the art industry and orders poured in.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q58.explanationZh: delicate 意为“细腻的”，修饰 brushstrokes“笔触”；“订单纷至沓来”可译为 orders poured in。

q59.sampleAnswer: Due to the bad weather, the open-air concert which the children are looking forward to has to be delayed for two weeks.
references: Due to the bad weather, the open-air concert which the children are looking forward to has to be delayed for two weeks.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q59.explanationZh: 音乐会“被推迟”，用被动语态 be delayed；“心心念念的”用定语从句 which the children are looking forward to。

q60.sampleAnswer: The scenery was beautiful beyond description.
references: The scenery was beautiful beyond description.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q60.explanationZh: beyond description“无法形容”，放在形容词 beautiful 之后。

q61.sampleAnswer: So demanding is the job that few people are equal to it.
references: So demanding is the job that few people are equal to it.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: demanding“要求高的”；so ... that ... 句型，so + 形容词放句首时主谓倒装；be equal to“胜任”。

q62.sampleAnswer: Since you are no longer a child, you can’t always depend on your parents.
references: Since you are no longer a child, you can’t always depend on your parents.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: depend on“依靠”；“不再是”用 no longer。

q63.sampleAnswer: There is no denying that prices are mainly determined by the supply and demand on the market.
references: There is no denying that prices are mainly determined by the supply and demand on the market.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: There is no denying that...“无可否认……”；“取决于”可用 be determined by。

q64.sampleAnswer: What delighted me most was that her present was just what I was thinking of buying myself.
references: What delighted me most was that her present was just what I was thinking of buying myself.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: delight 作动词“使高兴”，用 What delighted me most was that ... 的主语从句结构。

q65.sampleAnswer: Our school is making every effort to meet the demands of students for activities after class.
references: Our school is making every effort to meet the demands of students for activities after class.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: demand 作名词“需求”，meet the demands of ...“满足……的需求”；“不遗余力”用 make every effort。

q66.sampleAnswer: It is three years since Stephan graduated from Oxford with a master’s degree in English literature.
references: It is three years since Stephan graduated from Oxford with a master’s degree in English literature.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: a master’s degree“硕士学位”；“……已经三年了”用 It is three years since ...。

q67.sampleAnswer: At the exhibition, the company’s sales manager demonstrated the new type of electronic toys which children had been looking forward to.
references: At the exhibition, the company’s sales manager demonstrated the new type of electronic toys which children had been looking forward to.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: demonstrate 意为“展示；演示”，过去的事用 demonstrated；“翘首以盼”用 look forward to。
